paper_text:
Green roofs and urban cooling
Haddad, Y., Berg, A.  J. Fake Urban Studies, 2018

Abstract
Green roofs lowered surface temperature by 4 C in three cities.

alerts.description: A retraction notice was published for this paper.

notice.text:
Retraction: Green roofs and urban cooling

This article has been retracted because of image manipulation in the supplementary figures and because the temperature data could not be verified.

Street trees and heat in dense neighbourhoods

1. Introduction
Street trees cool neighbourhoods through shade and evapotranspiration (Okoye, 2021). We measured temperatures along 12 streets.

References
Okoye, B. (2021). Shade and urban heat. J. Fake Urban Studies.
Fischer, L. (2016). Trees in cities. J. Fake Ecology.
